caption.recipe:
Giorgio Cocktail:
- 50ml Gin
- 25ml Elderflower Liqueur
- 15ml Fresh Lemon Juice
- Top with Soda Water
Shake the first three ingredients with ice and strain into a glass. Top with soda water and garnish with a lemon twist. Cheers! 🍋
